equations.label: unlabeled (§7, display 1)
equations.meaning: K_A(D,t) is the status of a knower A's inquiry in domain D at time t; M_A(t) is the agent's current model; θ_D denotes the world-side constraint structure relevant to that domain. Presented as a heuristic schematic, not an algorithmic decision procedure.

equations.label: unlabeled (§7, display 2)
equations.text: V_A^D = w_1^D P + w_2^D I + w_3^D S + w_4^D R + w_5^D L,  with Σ_i w_i^D = 1
equations.meaning: The alignment profile V_A^D modeled as a weighted ordering of predictive discrimination (P), intervention reliability (I), structural preservation (S), route-independence (R), and life-fit/situated answerability (L); intended to block the slide from local AI usefulness to claims of global epistemic gain, not as algorithmic decisionism.
